newsitem.title: FINLAND: Huhtamaki falls sharply despite strong HEX.
newsitem.headline: Huhtamaki falls sharply despite strong HEX.

text.p: Shares in Finnish confectionery and packaging group Huhtamaki Oy fell sharply on Tuesday amid profit-taking and lack of demand, despite a relatively strong general mood and records on Wall Street, brokers said.
At 1510/1210 GMT, Huhtamaki traded at 160.00 markka, down 5.00 markka or 3.03 percent. Volume was a moderate 4.3 million markka.
There was talk of recent sell recommendations on the stock but brokers said there were no news that should move the share.
"There is nothing fundamentally new, a few rather large investors have been selling and continue to sell; the share is under pressure," one broker said, adding that demand was scant.
"If you want to sell, you have to go down in price," said another broker. Selling interest was both foreign and domestic, she added.
The share has been falling since it on September 2 reached a 174.00 markka year-high. It started the year just above 100 markka.
